title: objectql: a plugin driver's where with a non-node combinator operand is evaluated by the engine floor instead of refused (condition array → no rows, null element → every row)
body:
domain:server#6 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAnTcb4cZVkPdhkPicW

Filing gate: ① product defect with a named producer (class a, out-of-scope finding of PR #32248 for #32123; the seat files it, the dev does not).
reach: named producer. Any REST/SDK/MCP `find` whose `where` reaches an object served by a plugin driver (virtual objects, `driver-odata` and other plugin-published drivers): `packages/objectql/src/external-driver-floor.ts` applies the public export `applyDriverQueryInMemory` (`packages/objectql/src/driver-query-in-memory.ts`) to every plugin driver's `find` rows. ⚠ First step: measure reach once on a public entry (a REST `find` on a plugin-driver object), since the readings below were taken through the export.

## What happens

Measured by the #32123 dev through the export at `e9564f35` (PR #32248's merged head), on the shapes every native driver refuses `INVALID_FILTER` / 400 in `where`:

| `where` | Native drivers | Plugin-driver floor |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `{ $and: [[{ stage: 'won' }]] }` (condition array element) | 400 `INVALID_FILTER` | `[]`, no row |
| `{ $or: [null] }` | 400 `INVALID_FILTER` | both rows |
| `{ $not: 'won' }` | 400 `INVALID_FILTER` | `[]` |
| `{ $and: { stage: 'won' } }` (non-list) | 400 `INVALID_FILTER` | row 1 |

So one filter gets two answers on one verb, depending on which driver serves the object. The silent answers look like data.

## Expected

The floor refuses the same shapes in `where`'s words, before any row is read: `assertDriverWhereEvaluableInMemory` runs the drivers' shape gate. PR #32248 adds that gate to `packages/objectql/src/having-filter.ts` as `assertFilterNodeShapes(filter, root)` for `aggregations[i].filter` and `having`, so the fix is likely one call with root `where`, plus pins on the floor. That shape is unverified until #32248 lands.

## Business reason

Who: anyone querying a virtual or plugin-driver object (external systems over federation), and AI clients that write filters. Without it, a malformed filter returns a plausible wrong row set instead of a loud refusal, on exactly the objects whose data the platform cannot cross-check.

## Reader

The `domain:server` seat that claims it after triage, once PR #32248 (#32123) has landed (it introduces the shared gate). Same defect family as #32123: fold into that family's closing card if one is opened.

## Duplicate check

`gh api search/issues` with `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue` (open and closed), 2026-11-10: `applyDriverQueryInMemory` 5 hits (#32123 open; #27277, #27261, #31780, #29762 closed, all about the floor's existence, row cap or sync, not filter shape). `assertDriverWhereEvaluableInMemory` 1 hit (#32123). `plugin driver where combinator` 120 hits; the first five are #32123, #29888, #20039, #19885 and #24693, none about the plugin floor's shape gate. No card for this.
